name: [SUMMER] Nooby Battleground
desc:
Welcome to Nooby Battleground!

How to play? - Kill others people and become the strongest!

CONTROLS ARE:

G - Ultimate
M1 - basic punch
Q - Dash
M1 x3 + Falling M1 = Downslam
M1 x4 + Dash + Near Wall = Wall combo
M1 x3 + Hold Space + M1 = Uppercut
F - Block
1-4, R - Moves
B - Emotes

Tags (You can ignore): Noob, Nooby, Battleground, Fighting game, Fight, TSB, The Strongest Battlegrounds, Fake Tsb, Fake The Strongest Battlegrounds, KJ, Martial Legend, JK, Jun, Shinji
